MANDARIN — TERMLY EXAM #12
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In MANDARIN, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
   B. Only memorise without using the language
   C. Mix random languages with no purpose
   D. Avoid speaking to classmates

2. When practising Reading Aloud, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Reading Aloud.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Reading Aloud.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading Aloud.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Reading Aloud.

3. When practising Guided Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Guided Reading.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Guided Reading.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Guided Reading.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Guided Reading.

4. When practising Imitative Speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Imitative Speaking.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Imitative Speaking.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Imitative Speaking.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Imitative Speaking.

5. When practising Listening for Gist, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Listening for Gist.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Listening for Gist.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for Gist.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for Gist.

6. When practising Phonological Awareness, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Phonological Awareness.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Phonological Awareness.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Phonological Awareness.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Phonological Awareness.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
7. In three clear sentences, explain Listening for Gist and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

8. In three clear sentences, explain Listening for Gist and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

9. In three clear sentences, explain Imitative Speaking and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

10. In three clear sentences, explain Reading Aloud and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

11. In three clear sentences, explain Reading Aloud and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Reading Aloud and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
